Ubah suaian Peraturan-Peraturan

2. Peraturan-Peraturan Perkhidmatan Pembetungan (Caj) 1994

[P.U. (A) 115/1994] diubah suai pemakaiannya bagi Semenanjung Malaysia

dan Wilayah-Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya dan Labuan mengikut cara yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Perkhidmatan Pembetungan (Caj) 1994

Ubah Suaian

perenggan (c), potong perkataan

"sebagaimana yang dibenarkan

digunakan oleh Ketua Pengarah".

Subperaturan 4(2) Gantikan perkataan "Ketua Pengarah"

dengan perkataan "Suruhanjaya".

Ubah Suaian

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY ACT 2006

WATER SERVICES INDUSTRY (MODIFICATION OF THE SEWERAGE SERVICES

(CHARGES) REGULATIONS 1994) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 185(3) of the

Water Services Industry Act 2006 [Act 655], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Water Services Industry (Modification

of the Sewerage Services (Charges) Regulations 1994) Order 2018.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2018.

Modification of Regulations

2. The Sewerage Services (Charges) Regulations 1994 [P.U. (A) 115/1994]

are modified in its application to Peninsular Malaysia and the Federal Territories of

Putrajaya and Labuan in the manner as set out in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Provisions of the Sewerage Services

(Charges) Regulations 1994

Modifications

Regulation 2 In the definition of "annual value",

in paragraph (c), delete the words

"as may be allowed to be used by the

Director General".

 Subregulation 4(2) Substitute for the words

"Director General" the word

"Commission".

Provisions of the Sewerage Services

(Charges) Regulations 1994

Modifications

 Subregulation 5(2) Substitute for the words

"Director General" the word

"Commission".

Regulation 6A Substitute for the words "Director General

may apply such methods as in his opinion

appears appropriate" the words

"Commission may apply such appropriate

methods".

Regulation 10 Substitute for the words

"Director General" wherever appearing

the word "Commission".

In paragraph (c), substitute for the words

"regulation 6" the words "regulations 6

and 6A".

Made 29 January 2018

[KeTTHA.(S)100-1/1/6; PN(PU2)660/XIII]

DATUK SERI PANGLIMA DR. MAXIMUS JOHNITY ONGKILI

Minister of Energy, Green Technology and Water
